title: Vinyl Now Earns More Than Twice CD Revenue
hook: The format CDs replaced came back as the more valuable physical product.
closing: Vinyl won the physical comeback by becoming collectible inside a streaming market.
question: What record would you buy?

segments.say: Vinyl earned 1.2 billion dollars, more than twice CD revenue. The older format became the premium product.
Vinyl also sold 41 million albums, beating CDs in unit count. Higher revenue was not only a price effect.
Streaming still takes 84 percent of music revenue. Vinyl won a physical revival, not the whole market.
